summary: Empty-state short-circuit in formatForLLM returns terse one-liner when no content exists
context: Benchmark showed coordination overhead hurts in simple scenarios (conflict-resolution: -6 pts). The full section template was rendered even when empty.
rationale: When there are no warnings, decisions, findings, needs, handoffs, or questions, the full markdown template is pure noise. A terse 'No prior context for scope: X' eliminates this overhead completely.
